cohort: The study included 223,242 term singleton deliveries.
finding: Early-term delivery is independently associated with pediatric long-term hematological morbidity, with children born at early term having significantly more hematological hospitalizations up to 18 years of age.
gest_age: 37 0/7 to 38 6/7 weeks (early term); 39 0/7 to 40 6/7 weeks (full term)
